description: This file defines an interface 'AcknowledgementTopicPathBuilder' for building topic paths related to acknowledgements in the protocol adapter module. It declares methods for setting custom acknowledgement labels and removing labels to indicate aggregated acknowledgements.

classes.name: AcknowledgementTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for creating topic paths for acknowledgements, allowing customization of acknowledgement labels and indication of aggregated acknowledgements.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Sets a custom acknowledgement label on the topic path.

methods.name: aggregatedAcks
methods.description: Removes custom acknowledgement labels to signify aggregated acknowledgements.
